def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    r=next(i for i,row in enumerate(g) if any(x for x in row))
    for c,x in enumerate(g[r]):
        if x==2:
            h=4
        elif x==8:
            h=3

            g[rr][c]=1
    return g
